column2: The end of the Sun-Moon Fist. Beyond holding the sun and moon, you command them. As the fight ripens they rise in turn ever faster until the world halts at twilight, and in that twilight every move becomes something else.

Apex Passive · Sun-Moon Apex Shift: fill Apex (100) by landing and taking hits and a cutscene plays server-wide as the world turns to twilight for 40s. Meanwhile all skills become twilight skills (stronger), light and heavy damage x1.3. By day damage dealt +20%, by night damage taken -20%. All skill cooldowns 30% shorter. Has an Ultimate Art (X)
Throw a sun disc and a moon disc to the sides. They fly forward in crossing arcs, burning and cutting enemies on the way, and meet 30 studs ahead in an eclipse burst
Burst a sun in place and vanish, reappearing 22 studs ahead (invincible). Moonlight cuts your path, and a crescent bursts in a circle where you land

The sun and moon rise behind you. The sun sweeps the ground ahead back and forth with a beam of fire while the moon drives down three giant crescents. They collide over enemies into an eclipse, the ground splits, and the eclipse sinks in and bursts into a dome of light

Ultimate Art. Cutscene: the world darkens and a giant sun and moon rise from both horizons behind you (invincible meanwhile). They orbit you faster and faster, striking enemies in turn (fire pillars from the sun, crescents from the moon). They collide overhead and a giant eclipse hangs in the sky, the world loses its color, and eclipse rays pour down. Punch the sky and the eclipse cracks and shatters into dawn light
Throw five sunset crescents in a fan. They fly 28 studs and return, cutting once each way
Become sunset and appear behind five nearby enemies in turn, cutting each (invincible). The sunset trails you left all burst at once

A giant setting sun descends from afar onto the ground ahead and the ground becomes a sunset sea. As the sun sinks, enemies on the sea burn and slow, four sunset waves spread and moonlight pillars rise. Once it's fully submerged the sea briefly cools and goes still, then erupts into a crown of sunset flame

Twilight Ultimate Art. Cutscene: the sky turns to sunset and a giant setting sun and moon descend from both sides (invincible meanwhile). They shrink as they're drawn into your hands, then leave them and race around the edge of the circle underfoot in opposite directions, drawing a ring of fire. Meeting ahead, they become an orb of twilight that rises overhead, pulls in the area, shrinks to a point, and the world bursts white in sunset light
Only those who build Null Fist mastery to 20 and are reborn three times meet the Grid Keeper in the Garden of Oblivion beyond the end of the world

The end of the Null Fist. Beyond erasing, you draw coordinates in emptiness. As the fight ripens, a white grid slowly unfolds from a single point where he stands, becoming a space, and everything inside that grid is his.

Apex Passive · Grid Deployment: fill Apex (100) by landing and taking hits and a server-wide alert appears as a white 3D grid space slowly unfolds from a point where you stand (4.5s) and stays for 30s (radius 100 studs, height 84 studs; the edges cut off into the void). Enemies inside are slowed and cut by the grid every 1s, all skills become grid skills, and light and heavy damage x1.3. Blank: a blank bursts every three hits. Glitch: 15% of attacks slip past you. Speed x1.3
Three white coordinate axes are drawn in a star shape in the air ahead. Space shifts up and down along the lines cutting, then snaps back and cuts again
Trap yourself and the nearest enemy in white grid boxes and swap coordinates (invincible meanwhile). You end up where the enemy stood and vice versa, then the box shrinks and bursts
A giant white grid cube forms in the sky above a nearby enemy and slams down. A grid is carved into the ground, each cell bursts red three times, then the cube scatters

Ultimate Art. Cutscene (invincible meanwhile): a white grid stretches from your fingertips into the sky. A dome of white grid sky forms over a 52-stud radius, and a giant blade of light slices space six times (space shifts with each cut). Everything stops, colors invert, then every grid line is sucked into one point and bursts white

For six enemies inside your grid space (wherever they are), the three grid lines through each (width, depth, height) light up red from end to end, then cut along the lines. The grid around them crackles red too
Run along grid lines turning at right angles, hitting five enemies in the space in turn (invincible). The grid lines you pass burn white
The whole grid space shrinks toward the densest group of enemies (lines turn red), pulling every enemy inside together. It holds briefly, then springs back open and that spot bursts white

Grid Ultimate Art (invincible meanwhile). The four walls of the space fold inward in four steps crushing enemies inside, press down from above and below into a single point, and the space is erased with them. The grid space ends here
Only those who build True Wind God Kick mastery to 20 and are reborn three times meet the Racing Ghost at the Hwangcheon Ferry in the Underworld

The end of the True Wind God Kick. Beyond outrunning the wind, you outrun sound and finally light. His fist is seen only after it lands, and only afterimages remain where he passed. As the fight ripens he becomes so fast the world seems slow, and he alone runs through it like lightning.

Apex Passive · Hyper Speed: fill Apex (100) by landing and taking hits and a cutscene plays server-wide as you enter hyper speed for 30s. Enemies within 90 studs are slowed (move x0.35), your stride x1.6, and every hit strikes again 0.2s later as an afterimage for half damage. All skills become hyper-speed skills (stronger), light and heavy damage x1.3. Acceleration: each hit speeds you up 5% (up to 5 stacks; resets if you don't hit for 3s, halves when you're hit). A sonic shock every four hits. All skill cooldowns 28% shorter. Has an Ultimate Art (X)
Fire your body as light, piercing enemies 34 studs ahead (invincible). A line of light remains, then the whole line bursts at once for another cut
Break the sound barrier and run 26 studs (invincible). The moment it breaks, a white vapor cone bursts behind you and enemies it touches are flung away
Vanish and cross the area ten times in a star pattern (invincible). Each path leaves a line of light that cuts enemies passing through, and at the end all lines flash and burst at once

Ultimate Art. Short cutscene (invincible meanwhile): crouch at the starting line. Three ever-longer dashes: sonic, light speed, beyond light. The first breaks sound, the second becomes light, the third leaves not even a trace. Every enemy on the path is cut, and at the end the sound catches up all at once in a shockwave
Flick your wrist to fire nine needles of light in a fan. They pierce 34 studs in an instant and vanish, leaving flashing lines
Leap forward five times like lightning, turning at right angles (invincible). Each landing bursts in all directions, and your path remains as a lightning trail
Run back and forth four times along a 64-stud road ahead (invincible). Each pass breaks the sound barrier, sweeping enemies on both sides to the middle, and finally a shockwave bursts at the center

Hyper Speed Ultimate Art (invincible meanwhile). Your body becomes an orb of light and bounces between enemies ten times at invisible speed. Lines of light remain like a web, and at the end you shoot into the sky and crash into the center like a comet as the whole web flashes

After 5 rebirths and all three Apex styles (Apex Sun-Moon, Apex Null, Apex Lightspeed), offer 9,990,000 silver to the man-shaped stone at the far northwest, then claim it at the altar in the cave below

The ultimate style beyond Apex. Not something new, but a return to the first fist. Heaven supports, earth grounds, man swings. Each time the arms circle the body, heaven, earth and man become one; one stomp and heaven and earth split.

Divine Gauge: fill Divine (100) while fighting to take Divine Form (until you fall). You float and fly, golden armor and a giant divine afterimage follow you, and all skills change (stronger, no domain). Body Arts: a style that fights with elbows, sweeps, knees, stomps and throws. Grab, spin and slam. Three Powers Tremor: every three light or heavy hits the ground shakes underfoot. The sturdiest blocks and deflects (balance x1.5), all skill cooldowns 25% shorter. Has an Ultimate Art (X)
Grab three enemies ahead at once, pull them in and slam them into the ground. The ground bursts where each lands, badly hurting nearby enemies too (bosses can't be grabbed and take the hit in place)
Raise your knee high and stomp. A shock spreads in all directions from underfoot, launching nearby enemies high

Grab five nearby enemies and swing them around with your whole body (invincible meanwhile). Every enemy you touch while spinning is hit, and at the end you hurl them all outward; the ground bursts where each lands

Ultimate Art. The same motion as when you earned it (invincible meanwhile): grab six nearby enemies and swing your arms six times, spinning them with your body. The moment you raise your knee and stomp, you hurl them all outward and heaven and earth split where each lands (bosses can't be grabbed and take the hit in place)
Awakened. Step in and uppercut skyward (enemy launches), slam down to earth, and pierce ahead with man's straight punch. Three blows in one flow (invincible)
Awakened. Stomp and the shock spreads outward in three waves. At the end the ground underfoot heaves up
Awakened. Gather the ki of heaven, earth and man for 1s and strike once. The fist pierces far ahead (invincible), a following shock spreads in a cone, and the distant ground bursts

Awakened Ultimate Art. The cutscene motion itself (invincible meanwhile): each of six arm swings bursts a big wave around you (growing each time). When you raise your knee and stomp, heaven and earth split, blasting a 48-stud radius with shock reaching out to 70 studs
Fly between five nearby enemies like lightning, kicking each twice (invincible). At the end you land and the area bursts
Soar high, then crash down on the nearest enemy like lightning (invincible). The ground splits four ways where you land, golden cracks racing far
Move among nearby enemies with divine steps kicking ten times (invincible), sweep a cone ahead, then split the ground in a 30-stud radius with a heel drop from the sky

Divine Ultimate Art (invincible meanwhile). The motion from when you earned it: while you swing your arms six times, time stops in a 70-stud radius binding everyone and the world cracks. When you raise your knee and stomp, heaven and earth split and everything shatters
Hands that grab like iron chains. Rather than trading blows, grab, throw and hurl. Thrown enemies crash into others and go down together.
Grapple: skills grab enemies to slam or throw them (enemies hit by a thrown enemy are hurt too). Every hit wears balance 1.3x
Grab the enemy ahead, pull them in and slam them into the ground. Nearby enemies are shaken too
Grab an enemy and hurl them far ahead. Enemies hit by the flying body and those where it lands are hurt too
Grab three nearby enemies at once and swing them in a big circle. Every enemy you touch while spinning is hit, then you hurl them outward
A fist against the current. It never strikes first. It takes a counter stance and waits, and the moment the foe comes in, returns their force as is.
Countercurrent: wide deflect window (0.34s), and successful deflects counter automatically. Hits taken during counter stance (E, G) deal no damage and are countered
A 0.9s counter stance. If hit during it, take no damage, slide up to the foe and counter hard
Turn your hands to push a strong wave ahead. Pushes away every enemy ahead and wears their balance a lot
A 1.6s counter stance (not invincible). If hit, slide up to the foe, strike three times, and a backflow bursts around you. If no one hits you, only the backflow bursts at the end
Punches that flow like a strong wind. Dart in short, launch the enemy, and keep hitting them in midair. Fast and light.
Combo: fast body (1.1x) and short dash cooldown (0.8s). Skills dart in to launch enemies and follow up in the air
Dart at the nearest enemy like lightning, hit twice and launch (invincible)
Follow a launched enemy into the air, hit three times and slam them down
Move between six nearby enemies like wind, hitting and launching them in pairs. At the end wind bursts at the center (invincible)
A fist that topples mountains. Slow and heavy. Hold Z to charge and release to split the ground and send enemies flying. Every blow wears a lot of balance.
Crush: hold Z (up to 1.6s) to power heavy strikes up to 2.6x. The body is slow (0.92x), but every hit deals balance x1.4 and knockback x1.2
Stamp to split the ground ahead. Rocks rise one after another along the crack
Drop a house-sized boulder on the nearest enemy's head
Gather strength for 1s and strike the ground. The ground around you rises like a mountain and collapses, launching everyone and hitting again as they fall
Only those at Brink meet the Ice Soul Nun before the frozen waterfall under the ice cliffs of the northern snow mountains
A palm that holds the soul of ice. Frost falls wherever it touches, and four hits freeze the foe. Its secret art covers the area in an eternal glacier.
Freeze: every four hits frost bursts at the target, freezing them for 1s (can't move)
Ice spears rise in a row ahead
Freeze the area, trapping enemies in ice for 1.6s, then shatter it with them inside
Ice pillars fall from the sky onto eight nearby enemies in turn, then a glacier rises underfoot
Only those at Limitless meet the Jade Sage seated among the jade pillars of the far-west stone forest
A fist carved from heaven's jade. Jade crystals bloom and stack with each hit, and its secret art turns the area into a jade forest that pierces everything.
Jade Crystal: every four hits a jade crystal blooms and bursts at the target. A sturdy body takes 10% less damage
Jade pillars rise in a row ahead, piercing
Chunks of jade fall on five nearby enemies
A jade forest grows wide underfoot, piercing every nearby enemy for 2.4s
Only those at Half-Immortal meet the Bell Keeper under the old bell atop the maple mountain in the far northeast
A fist that rings heaven's bell. Each blow builds resonance, and on the fifth the bell's toll spreads and shakes everyone around. Its secret art hangs a giant bell in the sky.
Resonance: every five hits a bell wave spreads around you (everyone nearby is hit). Sturdy guard (half damage when blocking)
Shout a bell toll ahead, shaking every enemy in the cone and breaking their guard
Cover yourself with a golden bell and ring the area for 1.2s. Every incoming attack is countered meanwhile
A giant bell hangs in the sky and rings ten times. Each ring sends a wave through the area hitting everyone
After one rebirth, find the Clear Mirror Immortal by the mirror pond in the middle of the misty tea fields at the far northwest
A fist like a clear mirror. Your self in the mirror fights alongside you. Every four hits a mirror clone strikes the same spot, and hits taken in counter stance are returned like a mirror.
Mirror: every four hits a mirror clone appears and strikes the same spot. E is a counter stance (if hit, no damage and you counter)
A 0.8s stance as still as a mirror. If hit, take no damage, appear before the foe and return their force
A mirror self appears before each of four nearby enemies and strikes twice
Ten mirrors stand around you. Light bounces from each into ten nearby enemies in turn
Ultimate Art. Sky and earth become mirrors. Three mirror selves appear before each of eight nearby enemies and strike, and at the end every mirror shatters and the area bursts
Only those who know the Heavenly Dragon Palm and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Heavenly Dragon Sage on the dragon-spine rock above the clouds east of Dragon Peak
The end of the Heavenly Dragon Palm. Each blast flies as a dragon, and its secret art covers the sky with a golden dragon. Fearsome at range and up close.
Dragon Ki: just 0.8s of holding Z fully charges a blast. The fourth combo hit and heavy strikes are dragon blasts. Every four hits a small dragon bites the target
Golden dragon energy pierces every enemy ahead
Rise like a dragon, launching every nearby enemy skyward
Nine gold dragons burst from the ground and coil into the sky, then slam into enemies one by one and burst at the center
Ultimate Art. The sky splits and a huge golden dragon descends. It slams down eight times, then breathes a searing blast forward
Only those reborn four times who know the Fist King Fist meet the Overlord seated on the fallen throne in the yellow-dust canyon in the far east
An overlord's fist beyond the Fist King. No flourish. Dart in, grab and hurl, erase everything ahead with a single punch. Every six hits, nearby enemies are forced to their knees by sheer presence.
Presence: every six hits presence bursts around you and enemies drop to their knees (frozen for long). Like the Fist King Fist, 10% of attacks miss you
Dart between the three nearest enemies in turn, landing a punch on each (invincible)
Grab the enemy ahead, lift them overhead and hurl them forward. Enemies hit by the flying body and where it lands are all hurt
Gather the world's ki into one fist for 1s and strike forward. Everything ahead is erased
Ultimate Art. The sky splits under your presence and golden lightning falls on nearby enemies nonstop for 2.4s, then you strike the ground and level the area
💎 Get it with the 'Nine-Tailed Fox Fist' game pass in the shop. More tails grow as you enhance it (nine tails at +15)
The style of a fox spirit cloaked in blue foxfire. Fast and light grazing strikes stack foxfire with every hit. More tails grow behind you as you enhance it.
Foxfire: every five hits blue foxfire bursts at the target. A light body (1.06x) lets 8% of attacks slip past
Five foxfires bloom in the sky and spiral down, striking five nearby enemies in turn and bursting into blue fire pillars
Leaving blue fox spirit clones behind, graze between four nearby enemies clawing them (invincible). Foxfire bursts as you land
Nine giant tail spirits rise from the ground and sway while foxfire meteors rain on nearby enemies; at the end the nine tails slam into the center and blue fire bursts
💎 Get it with the 'Black Flame Demon Sword Palm' game pass in the shop. As you enhance it, the black flame swords grow to two and blaze brighter
A demon-sword style that forges swords from black flame in your hands. One hand at first, swords in both hands from +5. As you enhance it, the flames thicken and burn purple and blood red.
Black Flame Brand: every six hits black flame bursts at the target. The final secret art, Black Flame Heaven Ender, rains flaming swords from the sky
